selection: Unchanged saved baseline plus 16 new candidates on the existing 512 features. Select by pooled inner correct count, five-class macro-F1, then declared order with baseline first. Only selected models score outer folds; no search expansion after outer results.
preprocessing: StandardScaler followed by real-fitting-only supervised ANOVA top128/top256/top512 or baseline-style PCA32. No extraction, synthesis, exclusion, new modality or gender. Only C=.003/.03 and weighting exponent0/.25 are new; old C=.001/.01/.1/1 and aggressive weighting/results are reused.
balancing: Weights (N/(5*n_class))**.25 or 1, normalized to original real fitting N. Each original participant contributes exactly one real feature row. No invented records or changed labels.
scope: Preserve all 275 participants (163train/56validation/56test), all original results and checkpoints. Same five outer/three inner folds and seeds42/137/2026. Training CV only; no new official validation/test scoring.
limitations: Repeated exploratory use of these training participants after prior holdout exposure is not independent confirmation. Negative ordinal and PHQ regression studies are reused, not retrained. No full-training refit unless a new procedure demonstrates a verified accuracy gain.
